sirna_potency.units: percent knockdown, higher is more potent
sirna_potency.evidence: Spearman 0.57 under target-gene-grouped CV, and 0.46 or better transferring between two independent studies with no shared sequences. It beats GC-only and asymmetry-only baselines, and a target-gene-mean baseline carries none of it.
sirna_potency.caveat: Trained on 2007 siRNA chemistry with no modification annotation, so it scores sequence design only and knows nothing about chemistry.

aso_activity.units: relative activity, higher is more active
aso_activity.evidence: Spearman 0.26 under target-gene-grouped CV. Above the GC-only baseline but modest, and it has no second study to transfer to.
aso_activity.caveat: Shown as a ranking aid only, never as a predicted knockdown.
